summary: Faved is a self-hosted bookmark manager designed to help you store, tag, and search through large collections of web links. It provides a clean, minimalist interface focused on quick retrieval and organisation of saved pages.
goodFor: It suits users who manage extensive bookmark archives and prefer a dedicated, searchable local interface over browser-sync services.
watchOut: Development activity is currently slowing, meaning you might wait longer for bug fixes or new features compared to more actively maintained alternatives in this space.
deployNotes: As a containerised application, you will typically need to configure persistent volumes for your bookmark data and run it behind a reverse proxy to handle TLS termination.
